title: Primary clustering
notes: 22, 33 and 44 all start at slot 0 and pile up in slots 0 to 2. Then 1 and 13, which start at slots 1 and 2, land at the end of the run instead of in their own slots. By the time 55 arrives it needs 6 probes, and a search for a missing key that starts in the run walks all of it.
